notes:
The query cannot be fully answered from the provided schema because
IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL contains MAX_ENROLLMENT, TERM_CODE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE,
and IS_CANCELLED, but no SUBJECT_ID/DEPARTMENT_CODE/DEPARTMENT_NAME or
clear key linking an IAP activity to Mathematics. Therefore the
Mathematics-department subset of IAP activities cannot be determined
reliably, preventing computation of the requested variance and STDDEV.
question_text: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics department subjects offered in terms within that year, the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department (considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for those IAP activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
